slide_title: Goals–Understand the location andpurpose of:–Illumination source–Lenses–Apertures–Detectors–Understand the relationship between size and scale–Understand what magnification and resolution mean and how they are related
original_text: Goals–Understand the location andpurpose of:–Illumination source–Lenses–Apertures–Detectors–Understand the relationship between size and scale–Understand what magnification and resolution mean and how they are related
explanation: This slide lists the learning objectives for the microscopy unit. Students are expected to understand the location and purpose of four key microscope components: the illumination source, lenses, apertures, and detectors. They must also comprehend the relationship between size and scale, and understand the meanings and relationship between magnification and resolution.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT listed as a key microscope component students must understand on this slide?
questions.exp: The list of components is: 'Illumination source', 'Lenses', 'Apertures', and 'Detectors'.
